value.rationale: The sixth finite subset space of the two-sphere is 5-connected, so H6 is its first possible nonzero integral homology group. Nonzero 3-torsion is invisible to known rational homology and naturally extends the complete low-cardinality integral computations. An exact significant integral invariant of a canonical topology functor can be independently useful without a full homotopy classification.
